headline: Splitting the styled primitives across modules costs the styled perf runtime little; the css-prop fold has no `styled(...)` wrapper to lose across the boundary and still ties `vanilla` on payload and SSR.

microbench.why: With the primitives imported rather than local, the css-prop fold still concatenates the chain to one class and renders at 0.915 ms/1k, near `vanilla` (0.827) and `StyleX` (0.899). The styled perf runtime renders at 1.48 ms/1k with a 0.558 ms library slice. The hashers trail, `styled-components` 2.87 ms/1k, `emotion` 5.88.

autocannon.why: The single-class fold serves 634 req/s against `vanilla`'s 718; the styled perf runtime's per-primitive wrappers hold it to 431. `StyleX` reaches 524, the runtime hashers far less, `emotion` 135 req/s.

attribution.why: The css-prop fold renders in 1.25 ms with a 0.156 ms library slice, just over `vanilla` (1.23 ms). The styled perf runtime pays 0.558 ms of library time for the imported wrappers and reaches 2.11 ms. `emotion` burns 4.37 ms of 7.30 ms in the hash, `styled-components` 1.81 ms in `generateAndInjectStyles`.

hydrate.why: The css-prop fold hydrates with `vanilla` at 46.5-46.8 ms; the styled perf runtime's wrappers cost it 53.3 ms. The runtime hashers inject and reflow, `emotion` 98.2 ms, `goober` 192 ms, `styled-components` 195 ms.

inp.why: A tab select re-renders a small subtree in ~6.90-7.70 ms across the static-class lanes, a near tie. The hashers re-touch their sheet, `goober` 15.8 ms, `styled-components` 15.9 ms, `emotion` 27.2 ms.

mount.why: Cold mount parses one static sheet, so `vanilla`, the css-prop fold and `StyleX` land at 91.7-95.9 ms with the styled perf runtime at 101 ms. The runtime libraries add first-inject, `goober` 193 ms, `styled-components` 199 ms, `emotion` 224 ms.

renderTiming.why: One recalc for every lane; the module boundary changes the build graph, not the browser's style pass.

payload.why: The css-prop fold ships 2.39 kB gzipped, under `vanilla` (2.72 kB), unchanged from single-file `tabs` because folding the chain does not depend on where the primitives are declared. The styled perf runtime carries 3.46 kB. The hashers are 4.4-6.3× larger, `styled-components` 15.9 kB, `cnfast` 21.9 kB.

nsweep.why: At 4000 groups the css-prop fold holds at 35.6 ms near `vanilla` (30.4) and `StyleX` (31.9), while the styled perf runtime's imported wrappers compound to 69.9 ms. The css-prop fold sits a little above its `tabs` figure (32.9 ms) but keeps the flat-class curve where the styled path cannot.

crossCase: `multifile-composition` is the split-module twin of `tabs` above. Importing the styled primitives nudges the styled perf runtime from 1.45 to 1.48 ms/1k SSR; the css-prop fold concatenates classes without a `styled(...)` wrapper to resolve across the boundary, so it barely moves (0.842 to 0.915) and its payload is identical at 2.39 kB.
